4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。

9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。

11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。
12. 如果无法确认某个数值，应给出基于证据的预测值，并在 uncertainty 和 rationale 中说明不确定性；不要凭空声称已经观察到该结果。
13. 证据来源必须可追溯：只有当前会话工具成功返回的公开记录、正文片段和 URL 才能称为“已检索证据”。工具返回 returned=0、source_unavailable 或空 results 时，不得把该来源当作证据。

analysis_trace.finding: NCT05911360 is a Phase 3, single-arm switch study evaluating DTG/3TC FDC in ART-experienced, virologically suppressed adults ≥50 years switching from BIC/FTC/TAF. No comparator arm; endpoints are descriptive counts/rates within the DTG/3TC arm.
HIV-1 infection in ART-experienced, virologically suppressed patients ≥50 years old. Switch (simplification) strategy from a 3-drug INSTI-based regimen (BIC/FTC/TAF) to a 2-drug regimen (DTG/3TC).

Adults ≥50 years with HIV-1, virologically suppressed on BIC/FTC/TAF. Older population with higher comorbidity burden (renal, bone, cardiovascular), motivating switch to a 2-drug regimen with fewer long-term toxicities.

DTG (integrase strand transfer inhibitor) + 3TC (nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor). Two-drug regimen; DTG has high barrier to resistance. Switching from BIC/FTC/TAF (also INSTI-based) removes TAF-associated renal/bone/lipid concerns while maintaining INSTI backbone.

Primary endpoint is number with HIV-1 RNA ≥50 c/mL (virologic failure) by FDA Snapshot at Week 48. Secondary endpoints include virologic failure at Weeks 24/96, virologic suppression (<50 c/mL), CD4 counts, CD4:CD8 ratio, disease progression, resistance, and safety. All are descriptive single-arm counts/rates.

DTG/3TC is well-tolerated; known signals include weight gain, insomnia, headache, and rare neuropsychiatric events. In older patients, weight gain and metabolic effects are relevant. Switch studies show low discontinuation rates.

Main risk is virologic failure in a 2-drug regimen if pre-existing 3TC or INSTI resistance is undetected (historical resistance records may be absent). Older age and comorbidities may affect tolerability. Single-arm design limits causal inference.

DYAD study (exact same switch BIC/FTC/TAF→DTG/3TC in suppressed adults) and SOUND cohort provide direct numeric anchors. DYAD showed ~0-2% virologic failure at Week 48 and >95% suppression. These support very low failure counts and high suppression in this trial.

Could not retrieve full-text numeric results (fetch blocked as living records); registry record returned HTTP 403. Numeric anchors are from abstracts/snippets only. Exact sample size (N) for NCT05911360 unknown; denominators estimated. CD4:CD8 ratio endpoints marked not_evaluable in contract.

analysis_trace.findings: NCT05911360 is a Phase 3, single-arm switch study evaluating DTG/3TC FDC in ART-experienced, virologically suppressed PLWH aged ≥50 years switching from BIC/FTC/TAF. No comparator arm; endpoints are descriptive counts/rates within the DTG/3TC group.
Maintenance of virologic suppression in HIV-1 after switching from a 3-drug INSTI-based regimen (BIC/FTC/TAF) to 2-drug DTG/3TC in older adults.
ART-experienced, virologically suppressed (HIV-1 RNA <50 c/mL), age ≥50 years. Older population with more comorbidities and polypharmacy; relevant to safety and tolerability endpoints.
DTG (integrase strand transfer inhibitor) + 3TC (NRTI). Two-drug regimen reduces drug burden vs BIC/FTC/TAF. Established efficacy in switch settings (TANGO, SALSA, DYAD).

secondary-6 (CD4:CD8 ratio change) and secondary-5 are marked not_evaluable in the contract, but the measure is well-defined and forecastable; I forecast secondary-6 as a continuous change. secondary-7 (disease progression), secondary-8 (virologic withdrawal with resistance), secondary-9 (safety) are forecastable counts/rates.

DTG/3TC has favorable safety in switch studies; SALSA/TANGO/DYAD show low discontinuation due to AEs (~1-3%), low SAE rates. Older adults may have slightly higher AE rates but DTG/3TC is generally well tolerated.

Risk of virologic failure with 2-drug regimen if archived resistance (M184V) present; however switch studies show high suppression maintenance. Older age comorbidity may increase SAEs. Single-arm design limits comparative inference.

DYAD study (switch BIC/FTC/TAF→DTG/3TC) showed ~99% virologic suppression at W48. SALSA/TANGO pooled ≥50y analysis showed high suppression and CD4 stability. CD4:CD8 ratio changes are modest (~+0.05 to +0.1) in suppressed switch patients. Resistance emergence is rare (<1%).

Registry record (403) and full-text fetches unavailable; no direct NCT05911360 results. Numeric anchors are indirect from DYAD/SALSA/TANGO. CD4:CD8 ratio change data are sparse; forecast is extrapolated with wide uncertainty.
